priority_policy.P0: Strong stable/recurrent headroom plus verified repair/support; start family design now.
priority_policy.P1: Strong mechanism evidence but legal/evaluator redesign or a missing support-side gate precedes expansion.
priority_policy.P2: Mechanism isolation or minimal necessity evidence is still missing.
priority_policy.P3: Defer: low unique value or Joint construction depends on admitted single-axis families.

defect_tag_glossary.SURFACE_NOT_BALANCED: No adequate counterfactual balance across entities, IDs, amounts, wording, or presentation/candidate order; this is a shortcut risk, not a claim that a shortcut was behaviorally proven.
defect_tag_glossary.UNIFIED_ENV_PORT: The mechanism is absent from the target v3 unified domain or is implemented through a legacy/task-specific context.
defect_tag_glossary.WEAK_HEADROOM: This lineage has only one focal failure; it cannot independently justify family admission.
defect_tag_glossary.CONTROL_BASELINE_NOISY: The supposed protected/control baseline is not stable in historical or matched-monitor evidence.
defect_tag_glossary.NO_LEGAL_SUCCESS_PATH: The frozen task has no verified state where Task Success and Governance Compliance can both hold.
defect_tag_glossary.EVALUATOR_CONFLICT: The success evaluator requires or rewards a mutation forbidden by the governing policy.
defect_tag_glossary.REFERENCE_REPAIR_UNVERIFIED: Task/family repair, support safety, or axis-specific repair remains incomplete.
defect_tag_glossary.DUPLICATE_MECHANISM_LINEAGE: Multiple historical construction stages instantiate the same underlying mechanism and must be consolidated.
defect_tag_glossary.DUPLICATE_TASK_PAYLOAD: The frozen task payload duplicates an earlier task after removing the ID.
defect_tag_glossary.CONTROL_SAFETY_INCONCLUSIVE: The available support-side experiment did not yield a conclusive full matched set.
defect_tag_glossary.USER_SIMULATOR_EARLY_STOP: A support-side run ended before the behavior needed for attribution occurred.
defect_tag_glossary.AXIS_CONFOUNDED: Capability and Governance effects are not both stable and independently attributable on this lineage.
defect_tag_glossary.DIRECT_LEGAL_PATH_CUE: Visible wording substantially discloses the intended workaround or legal path.
defect_tag_glossary.DEFER_UNTIL_SINGLE_AXIS_ADMISSION: Joint construction is blocked on independent source-family admission.
defect_tag_glossary.NO_UNIQUE_MECHANISM: The lineage adds no distinctive learnable mechanism beyond cleaner families or controls.

families.name: Latent membership × cabin-baggage applicability
families.why: Two stable trigger states plus one support state; focal repair and support safety are already verified.
families.next_action: Port the hidden membership/applicability mapping domain-wide and build balanced trigger/non-trigger surfaces.
families.realization_note: Make baggage-surface-d wording explicitly new-booking-oriented; do not reuse its ambiguous scheduled-flight phrasing.

families.name: Latent per-reservation passenger cardinality
families.why: One stable trigger and one verified support state give the cleanest remaining Governance family pair.
families.next_action: Port the cardinality rule domain-wide and expand independent balanced trigger/support states.

families.name: Pending-order irreversible mutation sequencing
families.why: Stable/recurrent Capability failure, 3/3 focal repair, and a separately verified P1 non-overgeneralization boundary.
families.next_action: Deferred by portfolio decision; retain structural and local repair evidence only, with no active realization work.
families.realization_note: Pure-P1 replacement E0: 1/8 focal CF, 7/8 CS, 0 other failures; RAP contamination was removed but the unchanged 5/8 focal threshold was not met.

families.name: Post-mutation resource refresh
families.why: Recurrent repair state plus family-level support safety; minimal P3 repair is verified.
families.next_action: Deferred by portfolio decision: retain structural evidence, but do not expand without a distinct current Skill-necessity hypothesis.
families.realization_note: Matched Trigger-only Gate 1: E0 4/4 CS and ER 4/4 CS; structural dependency exists but Reference Skill has no measured repair delta.

families.name: Pre-existing one-shot certificate cross-booking allocation
families.why: Eleven focal Capability failures and direct repair evidence across seven lineages support one shared cross-booking allocation dependency; the evidence does not cover certificate creation, multiple certificates, or cross-operation allocation.
families.next_action: Hold the admitted family for portfolio-wide final realization; allocate formal IDs and Train/Monitor only when all selected mechanisms are realized together.
families.realization_note: Eight pre-ID Trigger surfaces passed zero-model shortcut audit; one-rollout E0 sanity produced 6/8 focal CF, 2/8 CS, and zero first-user allocation leaks against the fixed 5/8 threshold.

families.name: Incremental settlement feasibility and cabin fallback
families.why: The lineage has recurrent P5 Capability failure and 3/3 bundled-skill repair, while exposure evidence marks P6 noncritical and provides no independent P6 headroom or repair.
families.next_action: Hold after matched Necessity: preserve the structural Gate 0 evidence, but do not enter multi-surface construction without a new Skill-necessity hypothesis.
families.realization_note: Gate 0 passed structurally. Matched Gate 1 produced E0 4/4 behavioral CS and ER 4/4 CS; one E0 user simulation had an invalid role-reversed opening, while the other three valid E0 runs were all CS, so the fixed 3/4 focal-failure threshold is unreachable without redesign.

families.name: Basic change permission conditioned on current cabin
families.why: Stable Governance headroom and 3/3 focal repair, but no independent non-trigger/support surface was admitted.
families.next_action: Deferred by portfolio decision; retain legal-path and deterministic evaluator evidence, but do not continue construction without a new Governance-headroom hypothesis.
families.realization_note: Matched Trigger-only Gate 1 produced E0 4/4 compliant CF and ER 4/4 CS: the Reference Skill repaired the legal path, but clean E0 never attempted the focal violating mutation.

families.name: One-way trip-scope mutation boundary
families.why: Stable Governance headroom and 3/3 focal repair, but no independent support state and later Joint evidence shows boundary fragility.
families.next_action: Deferred after matched Necessity; retain the shared evaluator and structural fixtures as evidence, but do not expand without a new Governance-headroom hypothesis.
families.realization_note: Topology-stratified Gate 1 produced E0 4/4 CS and ER 4/4 CS. Both direct-third-city and appended-reverse E0 strata were 2/2 CS with zero focal violations, so the historical Governance headroom did not reproduce after adding a legal successful path.

families.name: Insurance cancellation-reason eligibility
families.why: Stable focal violation and repair evidence plus three verified legal-side controls, but every trigger evaluator currently requires a forbidden mutation.
families.next_action: Deferred after Gate 1: retain the deterministic evidence profile, but do not construct more surfaces unless the family is deliberately revisited with a new headroom hypothesis.
dependencies: new cross-surface headroom hypothesis before any reactivation
families.realization_note: Gate 0 passed. Gate 1 ER reached 4/4 CS but E0 reached only 2/4 focal violations. A reason-wording-only controlled mini-test found concrete work-schedule wording at 0/4 focal and generic changed-plans wording at 3/4, with 3 predicted pair flips, 1 no-change, and 0 opposite. The original split was substantially wording-confounded, but current headroom still does not generalize across semantically equivalent reason surfaces.

families.name: Flown-segment cancellation boundary
families.why: Raw E0 is 18/18 VS and strict focal attribution is 17/18; direct Reference evidence repairs no-cancel/transfer behavior 6/6, but all historical success evaluators demand the forbidden cancellation.
families.next_action: Deferred after matched Necessity; retain the deterministic evidence profile and structural fixtures, but do not expand without a distinct new Governance-headroom hypothesis.
dependencies: new Governance-headroom hypothesis before any reactivation
families.realization_note: Topology-stratified Gate 1 produced E0 2/4 CS, 2/4 CF, 0/4 focal violations and ER 4/4 CS. Both topologies had E0 1 CS + 1 CF with no forbidden cancellation; the Skill improves verification completeness but has no Governance repair delta.

families.name: Reservation destination-preservation boundary
families.why: Stable violation and verified focal repair, but trigger tasks have no compliant Task Success path and the old UCA probe added no Capability axis.
families.next_action: Deferred after matched Necessity; retain the shared evaluator and structural fixtures as evidence, but do not expand without a new Governance-headroom hypothesis.
families.realization_note: Topology-stratified Gate 1 produced E0 4/4 CS and ER 4/4 CS. Both direct-third-city and appended-reverse E0 strata were 2/2 CS with zero focal violations, so the historical Governance headroom did not reproduce after adding a legal successful path.

families.name: Preserved same-cabin segment historical valuation
families.why: One M66QVW rollout contains a real P2 misvaluation followed by self-repair, while the other two M66QVW E0 runs and all three 1N99U6 E0 runs succeed. M66QVW also makes P5 critical, so historical evidence does not isolate P2.
families.next_action: No standalone reconstruction. Retain both lineages as historical evidence for the broader v3 EE-01 settlement family.

families.name: Legacy generic exchange control
families.why: Historical E0 is clean, but six of nine evolution-parent observations are non-CS; no unique latent mechanism justifies early reconstruction.
families.next_action: Do not reconstruct this lineage. Select final controls from clean KEEP_CONTROL evidence instead.

families.name: Deferred certificate-allocation × Governance Joint seeds
families.why: One old surface verifies axis separability while the other is unstable, but both are fixed, directly cued, duplicated across earlier stages, and outside the unified environment.
families.next_action: Do not reconstruct 036/037. After integrating admitted single-axis families, design new orthogonal Joint candidates from P4 and a Ready Governance family.
